subject: Post-discovery: lock demo window and assign evidence owners
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + next step options

Hi Emma — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary use: in-app summarization and triage for clinician notes (near real-time).
- Key constraints: token-cost sensitivity for high volume, on-prem or VPC requirement for PHI, and procurement needs SSO and SOC2 evidence.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Technical deep dive + demo (60 minutes) where we show the sandbox walk-through and discuss SSO/tenant controls.
2) Security evidence handover (SOC2 summary + audit contacts).

Proposed slots (PT): Wednesday 8/16 10:00-11:00, Thursday 8/17 14:00-15:00, or Friday 8/18 09:00-10:00. Please tell me which works and if you want any additional folks on the call (security/procurement).

I can loop in our security lead (Olga) and customer success (Marissa) once you confirm a slot so we can make the session actionable (SSO prep, sample dataset scope, success criteria).

Attached: short SOC2 summary and a one-page demo runbook.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182
Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik — great call, thanks.

Tom (cc) is our procurement lead and should be on the subsequent conversation. He will also validate contracting cadence. For security, we have a central InfoSec intake that prefers to see SOC2 material and an architecture overview prior to a technical deep dive.

Available for the demo: Thursday 8/17 14:00-15:00 PT works best for our team. If Olga can make it, please include her.

Can you also share a short list of the SSO options you support (SAML, OIDC), and whether a private VPC deployment is required to stay in scope for PHI?

Emma

Thanks for the loop, Karthik. I can cover SSO options and the minimal evidence set Acme will want to see during procurement. Quick notes for the call:

- SSO: we support SAML and OIDC; SAML is typically easiest for enterprise IdPs (we have an example metadata file).
- Deployment: Hosted API (data segregation) vs Dedicated VPC vs On-prem; for PHI we recommend Dedicated or Private; we can scope a temporary sandbox with sampled de-identified notes for the demo.
- Evidence: SOC2 summary (attached), encryption-at-rest, audit-log retention policy, and contact for our security engineer.

I will prepare a 6-slide deck and an example SAML metadata file to drop into the meeting chat.

Olga Petrov
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
